claims.statement: CLN02 averaged 513.13 across 10 lots versus CLN01 at 502.1 across 10 lots with p-value of 0.0024
High lots from CLN02 ran on different chambers including 519.22 on DEP02-B and 520.14 on DEP02-A and 518.92 on DEP01-B
CLN01 lots in the same window stayed normal including 501.87 and 501.66 and 500.74
MET01 averaged 507.63 versus MET02 at 507.6 with p-value of 0.994 so metrology does not explain the shift

disposition.summary: Alarm lot LOT-1239 from CLN02 reads high at 518.67. All recent high lots share CLN02 but span three deposition chambers and both metrology tools, while CLN01 lots stay normal. The source is the CLN02 clean step, so the lot is held and CLN02 is escalated.
